query.text: 请帮我留意老人穿衣的情况，遇到困难或还没穿好时告诉我，并提示下一步怎么做。
query.text_en: Please watch the older person getting dressed. Tell me if they are having difficulty or are not fully dressed, and suggest the next step.

annotation.text_zh: 外套搭在肩膀上了，需要把手伸进袖子里哦。
annotation.text_en: Your coat is just draped over your shoulders; you need to put your arms through the sleeves.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
